messages:
samir: Ran the concurrency sweep on cedar-int8 this morning. Dashboard: https://redwood/internal/dash/cedar-int8/sweep
samir: At concurrency 48-64 we see tokens/s drop ~3x and p99 jump from 180ms -> 820ms. cost/token doubled. Repro command:
```bash
python infra/eval/runner.py --model cedar-int8 --concurrency 64 --seq-len 1024 --batch-size 1 --requests 10000 --dataset eval_squad_small
```
samir: attaching runner log snippet below.
```text
[2026-02-12 09:12:03] INFO selected_kernels: use_optim_attn=true
[2026-02-12 09:12:03] WARN kernel_fallback: falling back to generic_attention on GPU 1 for layer 17
[2026-02-12 09:12:03] WARN kv_cache: evict_count=12
[2026-02-12 09:12:04] METRIC tokens/s=1120
[2026-02-12 09:12:30] METRIC tokens/s=380
```
kimberly: hmm looks like kernel fallback + KV evictions. p50/p99 numbers?
samir: p50 stayed ~90ms, p99 jumped to 820ms. cost/token baseline ~0.0012 -> 0.0036 at high concurrency.
jordan: possible inter-GPU memory pressure, maybe the quantized path triggers a different allocator causing migrations. saw a similar pattern in 2025-11.
dana: stacktrace from runner when it hit OOM on GPU 1:
```text
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.2 GB
  at inference/kernel_selector.py:478
  at eval/runner.py:212
```
ci-bot: Build #4421 failed: eval/quant-sweep (flaky) — https://ci/internal/4421
kimberly: could be our batching/async queue sizing. If queue backs up, we hit fallback path. Can we force single-worker per GPU for quant builds and rerun?
samir: I can run a targeted reproducer tomorrow with env VARS: QUANT_FORCE_KERNEL=no, KV_CACHE_WARMUP=1
jordan: also add an assert in runner to log kernel selection per-request and alert if fallback rate > 5% during sweep.
dana: I'll add the kernel-selection histogram to the dashboard (panel: int8_kernel_fallback_rate).
samir: opened ticket RW-2987 with logs and reproducer cmd https://go.redwood/RW-2987
kimberly: For CI: add small sweep job with concurrency 16/32 and fail if tokens/s drop > 2x for same model.
samir: plan: (1) run repro (2) add assert+small CI job (3) dashboard panel + alert. Anyone object?
jordan: +1
kimberly: +1
dana: +1 :thumbsup:
samir: thanks all — will post results here.
